newsitem.title: USA: Gulfstream Q1 net up nearly seven-fold.
newsitem.headline: Gulfstream Q1 net up nearly seven-fold.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

Company recorded a provision for alternative minimum income taxes of about $2.0 million for the quarter ended March 31, 1997 and no provision for income taxes for the quarter ended March 31, 1996 principally as a result of utilization of net operating loss carryforwards. On a pro forma basis, assuming an effective tax rate of 37.5 percent the company earnings per share would have been $0.33 and $0.05 for the quarters ended March 31, 1997 and 1996 respectively.
At March 31, 1997, Gulfstream's firm contract backlog was 104 aircraft, about $3.3 billion of future revenues.
